# partitioning

PerformanceProfile pinning platform workloads to reserved CPUs

```yaml
stack:
  partitioning:
    enabled: true
```

## Settings

Profile CPU layout. reservedCpus and isolatedCpus are node-specific and must be set.

Under `stack.partitioning.config`. Maps merge across layers; lists are replaced whole.

| Key | Description | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `reservedCpus` | CPUs reserved for platform/infrastructure workloads, e.g. "0-1" | `''` |
| `isolatedCpus` | CPUs left isolated for application workloads, e.g. "2-31" | `''` |
| `nodeSelector` | Nodes the profile applies to. Defaults to control-plane nodes. | `{}` |
| `machineConfigPoolSelector` | MachineConfigPool the profile applies to. Defaults to nodeSelector, then master. | `{}` |
| `numaTopologyPolicy` | Kubelet NUMA topology policy, e.g. single-numa-node | `''` |
| `realTimeKernel` | Install the real-time kernel | `false` |
| `globallyDisableIrqLoadBalancing` | Disable IRQ load balancing across the isolated set | `false` |
| `hugepages` | Hugepage allocation, e.g. {defaultSize: 1G, pages: [{size: 1G, count: 4}]} | `{}` |

## Policies

`<cluster>` is the ManagedCluster name, or hubName on the hub. `global.remediationAction: inform` overrides every action below.

Standards: NIST SP 800-53. Controls: CM-2 Baseline Configuration. Categories: CM Configuration Management.

### Policy `config`

`config-partitioning-<cluster>`: Workload partitioning PerformanceProfile.

| Template | Action | Renders | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `config-performance-profile` | enforce | [performance-profile](converters/performance-profile.yaml) | PerformanceProfile for workload partitioning |
